name: bound
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} to travel to it, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows the distance and direction to the amulet.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}.
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is magically bound to an amulet.
